lead: BRS vacates and restores commercial space, from furniture and IT removal to a clean handover, so you meet lease obligations with fewer loose ends.
card_blurb: Turn-key vacating of commercial space, including furniture, cabling and a compliant final handover.
meta_description: BRS decommissions offices: furniture dismantling and liquidation, cabling removal, recycling and a final walkthrough with property management.
overview: Office decommissioning is the systematic process of vacating and restoring a commercial space. It involves removing furniture, IT and signage, and returning the premises to original or lease-specified condition for the next tenant. It matters during moves, downsizing and closures.

It is more than moving out. It involves compliance, asset management (selling, donating, recycling) and a clean handover. Business Relocation Services (BRS) handles it as a turn-key service, from furniture to project management to the move itself.

benefits.title: Lease-ready handover
benefits.text: We work with property management to verify the required condition and complete a final walkthrough.

benefits.title: Fair value for your assets
benefits.text: We understand what drives market value and present only fair and reasonable offers. You keep ownership of items until they are sold.

benefits.title: Furniture dismantled with care
benefits.text: Cubicles and workstations have integrated components. Careful dismantling protects their resale value.

included: Meeting with property management to verify required condition and hours
Removal and liquidation or recycling of furniture, fixtures and equipment
Removal of modular systems furniture and complex filing systems
Removal and disposal of communication and network cabling
Removal of warehouse racking and air handling systems
Removal and disposal of trash and appliances
Broom-clean finish of carpet and tile flooring
Final walkthrough with property management for compliance sign-off

process.title: Confirm requirements
process.text: We meet property management to verify the required condition and working hours.

process.title: Dismantle and remove
process.text: We dismantle furniture and remove equipment, cabling, racking and appliances.

process.title: Sell, reuse or recycle
process.text: Liquidation and recycling target re-use rather than landfill where possible.

process.title: Clean and sign off
process.text: We bring floors to broom-clean condition and walk the space with property management.

who_for: Businesses with leftover furniture, IT or racking
Teams that must meet lease restoration terms

faq.q: What happens to furniture we no longer need?
faq.a: It can be sold through liquidation, donated or recycled. You keep ownership until items are sold.
